# Label Studio export fixture

`export.json` has the shape of a Label Studio JSON export (a list of tasks, each with `data` and
`annotations`; the choices hold the aliases of `data/labelling/label-studio.xml`). It was written
by hand from Label Studio's documentation, with invented headlines, **not captured from a real
export**: check it against the author's first real export (task 15) and replace it.

Cases: 11 labelled in the three families, 12 labelled and unsure, 13 answered with nothing chosen,
14 skipped, 15 never answered.
